rows.label: tlk70000024_05_msg0001
rows.name:
To be honest, Ryuuryuu underestimated
you at first, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000024_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Ryuuryuu thought outsiders shouldn't
come and mess with our place, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_05_msg0003
rows.name:
But now you're Knight-sama and the
party who saved the capital, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_05_msg0004
rows.name:
If Ryuuryuu and the others hadn't met
you, we'd still be all gloomy, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Ryuuryuu and the others really respect
you, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_05_msg0006
rows.name:
That's why... Ryuuryuu believes you
won't lose to that Heaven's Holy Grail
called Metsu, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_05_msg0007
rows.name:
...N-never mind what I just said, mo!
If my little brothers heard something
that sappy, they'd laugh at me, mo!
